title: The Vigil
text: Pilgrims keep an all-night vigil at a roadside altar, kneeling in a ring of candles, swaying, murmuring. Their eyes do not close. They invite you to join them. Some of them have been kneeling so long their knees have bled into the stone.

options.label: Kneel and keep the vigil, as the pilgrims do.

outcomes.text: A long night, a clear morning, and stiff legs that will not hurry.

options.label: Sleep instead. The road needs you rested more than the altar needs you kneeling.

outcomes.text: Rested, while the murmuring goes on all night around you.
